items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: the following band leaders called it quits: Woody Herman, Benny Goodman, Harry James, Les Brown, Benny Carter, Jack Teagarden

ctx.x: And in 1946, I had noticed this note and I wrote, the following band leaders called it quits: Woody Herman, Benny Goodman, Harry James, Les Brown, Benny Carter, Jack Teagarden, and so forth and so on. Was this something you guys noticed?

No I don’t think they called it quits — I think the big band era started to go in actually about ’48. When I got out of the Army I mean and I had the chance to audition for Les Paul, who at the time had a jazz trio. And I went up and luckily, thanks to my teacher and the technique he taught me you know, I could keep up with Les. And his idea of a ballad was about here [claps]. So I played with the group.
